layout_and_spacing.satuan_unit_display_rules: CRITICAL: The unit ('satuan') e.g. kg, ikat, pcs, bungkus, botol MUST be displayed prominently in bold tag alongside price (e.g. 'Rp 8.500 / ikat') on every Product Card, Product Detail Modal, Cart Line Item, and formatted WhatsApp message text.

navigation.desktop: Sticky Header with blurred background (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90), logo with fresh leaf badge, navigation links (Beranda, Produk, Kategori, Tentang Kami), Bekasi-Tipar Cakung location pill badge, and Floating/Header Cart Trigger with badge count.
navigation.mobile: Header with brand logo + cart button, drawer hamburger menu, and sticky Bottom Navigation Bar (Beranda, Produk, Kategori, Keranjang with badge count).

hero.visual: Asymmetric bento dynamic hero section. Left side features high impact text, location badge 'Bekasi • Tipar Cakung', CTA buttons ('Belanja Sekarang', 'Lihat Promo'), and trust metrics (100% Segar, Instant Delivery, Garansi Kualitas). Right side features interactive seasonal showcase card with high-res vegetable banner.
hero.cta: Primary button in Emerald Green with hover scale effect.

product_card.features: Product image with aspect-square object-cover, category badge, stock status tag ('Tersedia' vs 'Habis'), clear Name, Price in IDR, prominent Satuan Unit tag (e.g. '/ ikat'), Quantity Selector (+/-), and Add to Cart button ('+ Keranjang'). If out of stock, card shows grayed state with 'Habis' badge and disabled button.

product_detail_modal.features: Large image preview with zoom, detailed unit specification, stock count, description, freshness origin, quantity stepper, total price calculation preview, and immediate Add-to-Cart / Buy Now buttons.

shopping_cart_drawer.features: Slide-over drawer or page listing selected items, editable quantities with unit multiplier (e.g., 2 ikat x Rp 4.000 = Rp 8.000), single item delete, clear subtotal, estimated delivery note for Bekasi/Tipar Cakung, and direct button to Checkout.

whatsapp_checkout.features: Frictionless form capturing Nama Lengkap, Nomor WhatsApp, Alamat Lengkap (Bekasi / Tipar Cakung), Delivery Method selector ('Diantar Ke Rumah' vs 'Ambil Sendiri di Warung'), Catatan Tambahan. Auto-generates structured WhatsApp message encoded URL to send to owner.

floating_whatsapp.features: Sticky bottom-right glowing WhatsApp icon button for fast customer support or custom inquiry.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Javascript file implementation uses React with Tailwind CSS and Lucide React icons.
MUST retain data-testid attribute on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards, cart controls).
Implement Google Sheets API / Mock data adapter seamlessly for products catalog with complete Indonesian kitchen categories: Sayuran, Buah, Bumbu Dapur, Telur & Protein, Sembako, Minyak & Bumbu.
Make sure unit ('satuan') is clearly formatted e.g. 'kg', 'ikat', 'pcs', 'bungkus', 'botol', 'pack'.
WhatsApp checkout link must construct message text with customer details and line items formatted with quantity and unit.
Include empty state, skeleton loading animation, and Sonner toast notifications for user actions (added to cart, item removed, checkout submitted).
Provide PWA manifest support & responsive mobile bottom navigation bar.
